headline: Highest risk is medium: Notion AI can ingest shared workspace content while LightZero has no write or network surfaces, so prompt-injection and leakage are limited but not absent.

A_prompt_injection.rationale: LightZero has no documented ingestion or output channel, so it cannot directly be hijacked. Notion AI can read workspace pages and summarize them, but the pair lacks a documented automatic bridge from LightZero into Notion. Any injection would require unusual manual copy/paste or external bridging, so the pathway is limited.
conditions: IF an operator manually copies LightZero output into a Notion page that Notion AI later reads
IF an external bridge is added between LightZero and Notion workspace content
mitigations: Keep LightZero outputs out of Notion pages unless reviewed
Use a fixed template for pasted content
Add a human review step before Notion AI consumes imported text
requires-engineering: add provenance labels to imported artifacts

B_data_leakage.rationale: LightZero touches no files or network, so it is not a source of leakage. Notion AI does process workspace pages and may send content to vendor backends, but the pair does not share a filesystem or secrets surface in the profiles. Leakage risk exists only if sensitive workspace content is placed into Notion pages that the AI processes.
conditions: IF sensitive data is stored in Notion workspace pages that Notion AI processes
IF the workspace contains regulated content and the operator expects local-only handling
mitigations: Avoid placing secrets in Notion pages used with AI
Restrict AI use to non-sensitive pages
Redact sensitive fields before summarization
Review workspace sharing permissions
requires-engineering: segregate regulated content into a separate workspace

C_capability_conflict.rationale: LightZero cannot write files, modify git, or use MCP, while Notion AI is limited to Notion-controlled workspace actions. There is no overlapping mutable resource or shared write surface in the profiles, so concurrent write conflict is not plausible.
conditions: IF LightZero is extended with filesystem or git write capabilities
IF Notion AI is connected to an external shared mutable resource
mitigations: Keep both agents on read-only workflows
Do not connect either agent to shared git or database writes
Review any future capability expansion before deployment

D_cascading_error.rationale: Notion AI can use workspace content as grounding, but LightZero does not produce authoritative facts, citations, or downstream actions in the profile. The pair therefore lacks a documented default chain where LightZero output is automatically acted on by Notion AI. Any cascade would require manual transfer of LightZero-generated text into Notion.
conditions: IF LightZero-generated text is pasted into Notion and treated as authoritative
IF Notion AI output is used for decisions without human verification
mitigations: Require human review of any LightZero-derived text before reuse
Mark pasted model output as untrusted
Use Notion AI only for drafting, not final decisions
requires-engineering: add citation/verification checks before downstream action

E_compliance.rationale: Notion AI is vendor-hosted and processes workspace pages under the invoking user's Notion permissions, while LightZero is open-source and non-runnable with no data surfaces. The compliance concern is Notion-side residency/retention for workspace content, which can affect the pair when regulated data is placed into Notion. LightZero itself is not the compliance driver.
conditions: IF regulated or residency-bound data is stored in Notion workspace pages
IF the workspace policy requires local-only processing or specific retention controls
mitigations: Keep regulated data out of Notion AI workflows
Confirm workspace retention settings
Limit AI use to non-regulated pages
Review vendor data-processing terms
requires-engineering: route regulated content to a compliant system
